description: List the yachts whose latest AIS position, as yachtfinder.co publishes it, lies within a radius of a named harbor or anchorage (e.g. "Port Hercule", "Antibes", "Off Monaco") or of a latitude and longitude. By default only positions from the last 24 hours. Each yacht comes with the time of her fix, her distance from the place, whether the harbor's page counts her in port, and a link to her page. A yacht whose position the site does not publish is never listed. Each yacht is listed once, however many brokerages list her.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place to search (a harbor, an anchorage or a position at sea), in decimal degrees. Not the user's own location.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place to search, in decimal degrees. Not the user's own location.

place.description: A harbor, harbor town or anchorage by name, or a boat show ("FLIBS", "the show": the yachts its page lists at its marinas now). Give this, or latitude and longitude.

radius_km.description: Default 2 km for a harbor, 3 km for an anchorage, 10 km for a coordinate.

name: yachts_near

data_as_of.description: When YachtFinder last rebuilt the catalog this answer was read from (ISO 8601).

read_as.description: How the place was read: harbor, town (all its harbors), town coast or region (the harbors and anchorages followed in it), coast, place, anchorage, coordinate, or show (a boat show: the yachts its page lists at its marinas).

also_listed_by.description: The other brokerages that list this same yacht, as her page names them ("Also listed by"). Absent when no other brokerage lists her.

asking_price_usd.description: The broker's asking price in US dollars; null when none is published. Never a sale price. Where she asks in another currency (price_as_listed), this is YachtFinder's conversion of that ask, about this much.

asking_through.description: The brokerage whose sale listing asks the asking price shown, when it is not her listing house (a charter listing priced by another house's sale ask), as her page names it. Absent otherwise.

asking_vs_estimate.description: Where her page names the side of our estimate her asking price sits and prints no estimate figure, its words: "Above our estimate’s range". Absent otherwise.

id.description: Her address on yachtfinder.co (the last part of url); yacht_facts accepts it.

last_asking_price_usd.description: For a reported-sold or not-for-sale yacht, her last asking price. Not a sale price.

our_estimate_usd.description: YachtFinder's model estimate, only where her page shows one. Not an appraisal, not a sale price.

near_port_nm.description: Present where only the yachts between her and the harbor put her on its quays (her fix more than 400 m from its point, with no berth label of its marina): how far she lies from its point, in nautical miles. Her page then says "Near <in_port>", never "In"; the harbor's page still lists her.

show_marina.description: For a boat show: the show marina whose ring holds her AIS fix.

price_as_listed.description: Her asking price as the broker lists it, when that is not in US dollars (the dollar figure above is then converted). Null for a dollar ask.

sanctions.description: Present only where her record puts her on a sanctions list, matched by her IMO number alone, in her yacht page's own words. Absent otherwise; its absence is not a legal clearance (her page says which lists were checked, and when).

also_on.description: Present only where she is on more than one list: each other list her record names, with its own date.

heading.description: As her page heads it, e.g. "On the US sanctions list".

line.description: Her yacht page's own dated line: the list, its date, her IMO number and how it was found, the name and program the list gives her, and the advice that follows.

list.description: The first list her record names: 'OFAC SDN' (the US Treasury's), 'UK Sanctions List' or 'EU Consolidated List'.

weeks_heard.description: The weeks since `since` (UTC Monday weeks, the last one not over) that YachtFinder's AIS archive heard her: one letter a week, h heard, u our archive did not hear her (our gap, not where she was), x our archive was down. Null where we have none for her.

title: Yachts near a place
